potentialNumber.prognosisTitle: Keep up the current pace and he ends up around here at his peak. Based on his last 30 days.
potentialNumber.prognosisPastPeakTitle: He is past the age where riders peak.
potentialNumber.prognosisNoEstimateTitle: The prognosis comes once you have an estimate of his potential.
potentialNumber.prognosisModel2Title: The prognosis is where he is expected to end up at his peak if he keeps training as he does now, and it never goes above his potential, the scout's estimate of how high he can reach.
potentialNumber.prognosisBandTitle: This is where he will most likely end up if he keeps training as he does now. The range gets narrower with every day he trains on your team.
potentialNumber.aiTeamTitle: Riders on AI teams can't be scouted.
potentialNumber.potentialTitle: Potential, the scout's estimate. An estimate, not a fact.

table.ratingTitle: The weighted average of the abilities his own role needs. The same number means the same level in any role.
table.popularityTitle: Fan popularity (0-100). Existing board star-rider goals keep the measure they were agreed under.
table.reputationTitle: Race reputation. During the transition, it never shows below this rider's old popularity. The board reads this number for new profile goals.
table.pendingTransfer: Transfer pending: joining {team} once his current stage race finishes

filters.title: Filter the list to your budget
filters.body: Set 'Value max' to your balance to see only riders you can afford. The U25 / Free agent toggles open up cheaper paths.

list.title: Click a rider
list.body: The detail page shows full stats, contract status, and buy/auction options. You can start an auction or send an offer from there.

watchlist.title: Use the watchlist
watchlist.body: The star adds the rider to your watchlist so you can come back easily. The list also lives in the menu under Market: Watchlist.

emptyState.title: Build your first team
emptyState.intro: You have no riders yet. Use the filters below to find the riders that fit your strategy and budget.
emptyState.tipValue: Value filters = price ceiling in CZ$. Set max below your balance to see only affordable riders.
emptyState.tipStats: Stat filters = rider abilities like climbing, sprinting and time-trialling. Start broad and narrow down later.
emptyState.tipBudget: U25 / Free agent = budget-friendly paths: younger potential or riders without a contract.
